rationale: The stock has already recovered nearly the entire gap-down (from $46.66 low to $50.74, sitting at 99% of today's range and just $0.04 below the session high), meaning the easy directional move has already played out. With price pinned at the high on declining 1-minute volume and no news catalyst to explain the initial gap or sustain further momentum, there is no clear mechanical edge in either direction — a long here risks buying exhaustion at the top of the range, while a short faces strong intraday momentum and a broad market that is only modestly weak. Skipping preserves capital given the unfavorable risk/reward at this location.
